evidence: Clicking the application-count button on "QA Automation Engineer" expanded an "Applications (2)" panel listing the submitted applications for that job.

issue: Relative date off by one day
actual: Browser/system date confirmed as Mon Aug 24 2026 (current date). A job posted seconds ago displays "Posted Yesterday" instead of "Posted Today", and an application submitted seconds ago shows "Yesterday" instead of "Today" in the employer dashboard.

issue: Server/client does not enforce required-skill and salary min≤max constraints
actual: Posted "Test No Skill Job" with zero required skills — it was accepted ("Job posted successfully!") and appears in the dashboard with no skills. Posted "Test Bad Salary Job" with Minimum Salary $90,000 and Maximum Salary $50,000 (min > max) — it was also accepted and now shows "$90k - $50k" in the dashboard. Only the non-negative salary rule and title/description/industry/type/location required-field rules are enforced (via native HTML input validation); the skill-required and min≤max rules are not enforced and produce no feedback.

evidence: Clicking delete on "Test Bad Salary Job" showed a confirmation dialog ("Delete this job? ... cannot be undone") with Cancel/Delete. Confirming removed it from the employer dashboard (Active Jobs 8→7) and from the job-seeker listing (job no longer present among 10 shown jobs).
Filtering by Industry=Technology → 4 jobs; adding Location=San Francisco, CA → 2 jobs; adding Job Type=Contract → 0 jobs ("No jobs found"). Clear filters restored full 10-job list.
Each filter change immediately updated the "Showing N jobs" count and results (10→4→2→0), including a proper no-results message. "Clear filters" instantly restored all 10 jobs.

Searching "seleNIUM" (mixed case) matched the "Selenium" skill on QA Automation Engineer (1 result). Searching "cloudscale" (lowercase) matched company "CloudScale Inc" (1 result). Both updated results/count immediately.

actual: Employer Dashboard job rows only expose an application-count toggle button and a delete (trash) button; there is no edit/pencil button, link, or any other UI path to modify a published job's details. Job titles are plain (non-clickable) headings. Editing a published job is not possible through the UI.

After reloading http://localhost:6003/, the job list reverted to the original 8 seed jobs. The two jobs created during this session ("QA Automation Engineer", "Test No Skill Job") and their applications disappeared entirely, and the site is back to its pristine seeded state (no server/localStorage persistence of created jobs, applications, or deletions).
